Poster presented today at CTOS 2026 expands on the survival data first reported in the abstract (announced 11 November 2026), which showed a 12-month
disease-free survival (DFS) of 81.1% in patients with resectable soft tissue sarcoma.
Patients with post-treatment tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) levels above 310 cells/mm² had 95.0% 12-month DFS compared with 64.9% in patients with lower TIL levels.
Patients with treatment-related hyalinisation and fibrosis greater than 52% had 93.8% 12-month DFS compared with 71.4% in patients with lower levels.
Results build on previously reported strong pathological responses and further support the potential of efti-based combination therapy.

title: Immutep Limited (IMM) Reports 81.1% 12-Month DFS in Sarcoma Trial
